Independently recomputed all 16 ordered atom pairs with SymPy and established delta=(1+4theta−2theta²)/4, Var(L)=D/16 and Cov=(1+4theta−2theta²)²/16 for D=3+24theta−12theta²+16theta³−4theta⁴. Exact simplification verifies 5/11−rho=4(2theta−1)²(1+12theta−4theta²)/(11D). D>0 for every nondegenerate endpoint law 0<=theta<=1, the quadratic factor is strictly positive, hence unique equality at theta=1/2. This independent exact identity, not a grid, proves the full parameter range.
